limitations: Local H100 graph times include replay overhead; no official H200 score or transfer forecast.
Six-load sums use marginal per-shape medians from one full-policy run; ratios are descriptive, not an official calibrated score or a formal aggregate confidence interval.
Per-shape bootstrap intervals resample paired differences within one batch; they do not establish cross-run or H200 reproducibility.

One preparation per arm cannot establish selection-regret reduction; unselected variants have no full serving-timing sample. Confirmation-local ratios are screening evidence, not a counterfactual whole-policy gain. Separate fresh prepares choose different plans even on source-identical paths. Credit isolated EH only when geometry/control comparison supports it; retain all selection and timing differences.
Counter/immutable/terminal runtime PASS is asserted by the frozen reviewed driver and supported by complete completion records, not reconstructed tensor bytes after process exit.
